records.name: Shetland Museum and Archives
records.description: The Shetland Museum and Archives is a museum in Lerwick, Shetland, Scotland. The current building at Hay's Dock was officially opened on 31 May 2007 by Charles III & Camilla and Queen Sonja of Norway.

records.name: Lerwick Town Hall
records.description: Lerwick Town Hall is a municipal building located on Hillhead in Lerwick, Shetland, Scotland. It is used as an events venue and registrar's office. The building, which was also the meeting place of Shetland Islands Council until 2022, is a Category A listed building.

records.name: Lerwick Harbour
records.description: The port at the heart of the town, central to Shetland's fishing, ferry and offshore history.

records.name: Fort Charlotte
records.description: Fort Charlotte in the centre of Lerwick, Shetland, is an artillery fort, roughly five sided, with bastions on each of three landward corners, and half-bastions on the corners of the seaward face.

records.name: Clickimin Broch
records.description: The Broch of Clickimin is a large, well-preserved but restored broch in Lerwick, Shetland, Scotland. Originally built on an island in Clickimin Loch, it was approached by a stone causeway.

records.name: Scalloway and west mainland link
records.description: Lerwick is the natural base for day trips to Scalloway, west Mainland beaches and southern archaeological sites.

records.name: Bressay Island
records.description: Island just across the ferry from Lerwick with quiet roads, coastal walks, heritage sites and onward access toward Noss.

records.name: Gardie House
records.description: Historic laird's house on Bressay, adding architectural interest to the island's easy day-trip appeal from Lerwick.

records.name: Up Helly Aa Exhibition
records.description: Exhibition space celebrating Lerwick's famous winter fire festival, guizer squads and Viking galley traditions.

records.name: Bod of Gremista
records.description: Restored eighteenth-century fishing bod and birthplace of Arthur Anderson, co-founder of P&O.

records.name: Sands of Sound Beach
records.description: Accessible sandy beach on the south side of Lerwick with broad views across the Sound and Bressay.

records.name: Staney Hill Chambered Cairn
records.description: Neolithic chambered cairn on the hill above Lerwick, rewarding a short climb with expansive town and sea views.

records.name: Bressay Heritage Centre
records.description: Small island heritage centre interpreting Bressay's maritime, crofting and community history.

records.name: Shetland Crofthouse Museum
records.description: Thatched crofthouse museum showing traditional domestic life in Shetland before modern utilities.

records.name: Quendale Watermill
records.description: Restored horizontal watermill representing older grain-milling traditions in the South Mainland.

records.name: Stanydale Temple
records.description: Large prehistoric ritual or assembly building, one of the most intriguing Neolithic monuments in Shetland.

records.name: Eshaness Cliffs
records.description: Spectacular wave-cut cliffs and sea stacks formed within an ancient volcanic landscape on Shetland's west side.

records.name: Tangwick Haa Museum
records.description: Local museum in a laird's house telling the story of Northmavine and the dramatic Eshaness district.

records.name: Scord of Brouster
records.description: Important Bronze Age settlement site preserving the remains of prehistoric houses in western Shetland.

records.name: Ward of Bressay
records.description: High point on Bressay with commanding views over Lerwick, the sound and outer isles.

records.name: Ness of Sound Viewpoint
records.description: Coastal viewpoint on the western side of Lerwick overlooking the harbour approaches and nearby islands.
